# Set up Square POS

# Setting Up Square POS Integration

The Square POS integration allows OrderHub to automatically create orders and jobs whenever a sale is completed in your Square point-of-sale system.

---

## Prerequisites

Before you begin, make sure you have:

- **Admin access** to OrderHub
- A **Square Developer account** ([developer.squareup.com](https://developer.squareup.com))
- An application created in your Square Developer Dashboard

---

## Step 1: Gather Your Square Credentials

From your **Square Developer Dashboard**, collect the following:

| Credential | Where to Find It |
|---|---|
| **Merchant ID** | Developer Dashboard → your account settings. Starts with `ML...` |
| **Access Token** | Developer Dashboard → your application → OAuth or Credentials tab |
| **Webhook Signature Key** | Developer Dashboard → your application → Webhooks → Signature Key |
| **Location ID** *(optional)* | Developer Dashboard → your application → Locations |

---

## Step 2: Configure in OrderHub

1. Go to **Admin Setup**
2. Scroll down to the **Point of Sale Integration** section
3. Select **Square** as your POS Provider
4. Fill in the fields:
   - **Merchant ID** — your Square merchant ID (used to match incoming webhooks to your organization)
   - **Access Token** — used by OrderHub to fetch product details (names, categories) from the Square Catalog API
   - **Location ID** *(optional)* — if set, only orders from this specific Square location will be processed. Leave blank to accept orders from all locations
   - **Webhook Signature Key** — used to verify that incoming webhooks are genuinely from Square
5. Set your preferred **Default Order Status** (e.g., Confirmed, Pending, or In Production)
6. Ensure the **Integration Active** toggle is turned on
7. Click **Save Integration**

---

## Step 3: Configure the Webhook in Square

1. Copy the **Webhook URL** shown in OrderHub (it appears at the top of the POS integration section)
2. In your **Square Developer Dashboard**, go to your application → **Webhooks**
3. Click **Add Endpoint** and paste the webhook URL
4. Subscribe to the following event:
   - `order.updated`
5. Save the webhook

Square will now send a notification to OrderHub every time an order is updated. OrderHub processes orders once they reach a **COMPLETED** state.

---

## How It Works

1. A sale is completed in Square
2. Square sends an `order.updated` webhook to OrderHub
3. OrderHub verifies the webhook signature for authenticity
4. OrderHub fetches the full order details from the Square API
5. Product names and categories are resolved via the Square Catalog API
6. An order and its associated jobs are created in OrderHub

---

## Optional: Category Filter

If you only want to import certain product types from Square, you can enable the **Category Filter**. See the *POS Category Filter* help article for details.

---

## Tips & Troubleshooting

- **Orders not appearing?** Check that the webhook URL is correctly configured in Square and that the integration is set to **Active** in OrderHub.
- **Wrong products coming through?** Use the **Category Filter** to limit which product categories are imported.
- **Location filtering:** If you have multiple Square locations but only want orders from one, enter that Location ID. Otherwise, leave it blank to accept all.
- **Webhook signature errors:** Double-check that the Webhook Signature Key in OrderHub matches the one shown in your Square Developer Dashboard.
- **Access Token permissions:** Ensure your Square access token has permissions to read orders and catalog items.
